svg.title: Adafactor: optimal ELR under fixed bounds

cc:Work.dc:title: Adafactor: optimal ELR under fixed bounds
cc:Work.dc:description: Direct ELR conditional terminal-bound optimum for Adafactor, with common constant energy bounds. Fixed illustrative 5% warmup, normalized peak one, linear tail to zero. All axes linear. Warmup is not jointly optimized; no measured training results or universal optimality claim.
